1. Overview & Features

Welcome to Petika, an elite commercial single page portfolio website template designed for Senior Product Designers, Creative Technologists, Design Engineers, and Digital Consultants.

Petika combines a Neo-Editorial Bento Grid aesthetic with zero-dependency Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+) and Bootstrap 5.3.3. It operates straight out of the box with zero build step required.

Key Architecture Highlights

  • Zero-FOUT Dual Theme Engine: Instant dark and light mode toggle with pre-render persistence in localStorage.
  • In-Page Case Study Modals: Deep challenge/solution breakdowns without leaving the single-page flow.
  • Pure Vanilla JS Category Filter: Fluid category tab switching for projects with zero jQuery.
  • Live Availability Pulse: Animated indicator communicating availability status and timezone.
  • 100% WCAG 2.1 AA Compliant: Fully accessible contrast ratios, visible focus indicators, and screen reader skip links.

3. Quick Start Guide

Petika requires zero npm dependencies, zero build steps, and zero compilers.

  1. Unzip the package archive.
  2. Navigate to the HTML/ directory.
  3. Open index.html in any web browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
  4. To customize, open index.html and assets/css/style.css in your preferred editor (VS Code, Sublime, etc.).

4. Dual Theme & 60-Second Color Customization

Petika utilizes a 3-tier CSS custom property token architecture in assets/css/style.css. To rebrand the template with your own signature color, simply modify the accent tokens in the :root block:

/* In assets/css/style.css */ :root { /* Change Dark Mode Primary Accent */ --amber-500: #F59E0B; /* Replace with your primary HEX color */ /* Change Light Mode Primary Accent */ --amber-600: #D97706; /* Replace with your light-mode primary HEX color */ }

Updating these two variables automatically recalibrates all button backgrounds, borders, hover states, and badges across the entire template.

5. Setting Up Case Studies in the Interactive Modal

Projects are rendered as Bento cards in index.html. Each card contains data-project-* attributes that automatically populate the in-page modal when clicked:

<div class="bento-card project-card js-open-project-modal" data-project-title="NovaPay — Enterprise Fintech Design System" data-project-category="Product Design & Systems" data-project-client="FinScale Scale-Up" data-project-year="2025" data-project-desc="Your case study summary..." data-project-challenge="The core design bottlenecks..." data-project-solution="How you solved the problem..." data-project-tags="Figma,Design Tokens,Bootstrap 5" data-project-metrics="+34% Dev Velocity:Speed|+450 Components:Tokens" data-project-image="assets/images/projects/project-1-novapay.svg" data-project-link="https://yourdemolink.com"> ... </div>

6. Contact Form Setup

The contact form in index.html includes real-time client-side validation and simulated submission handling in assets/js/main.js.

To connect the form to a live email service (such as Formspree, Formkeep, or your own server API):

<!-- Example Formspree Integration --> <form id="contactForm" action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST"> ... </form>

8. Deployment Guide

Because Petika is 100% static HTML5, you can deploy it for free on any modern hosting provider:

  • Vercel: Drag and drop the HTML/ folder into the Vercel dashboard.
  • Netlify: Drag and drop the HTML/ folder onto the Netlify Drop app.
  • GitHub Pages: Push the HTML/ contents to a gh-pages branch.
  • Apache / Nginx: Upload the HTML/ directory to your /var/www/html/ or public_html/ folder.
